query: WITH due AS ( SELECT tenant_id, id, spend_day, reserved_tokens FROM generation_operations WHERE state = 'claimed' AND lease_until < now() ORDER BY tenant_id, id LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE generation_operations AS o SET state = 'accepted', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, reserved_tokens = 0 FROM due WHERE (o.tenant_id, o.id) = (due.tenant_id, due.id) RETURNING due.tenant_id, due.spend_day, due.reserved_tokens
